package.description: A disk defragmenter for Windows, which supports defragmentation of locked system files by running during the boot process.

en-US.description: A disk defragmenter for Windows, which supports defragmentation of locked system files by running during the boot process.
en-US.longDescription: UltraDefrag is a disk defragmenter for Windows, which supports defragmentation of locked system files by running during the boot process. It is easy to use without any complicated scripting or a huge load of configuration settings. You can filter the files processed by size, number of fragments, file name and path. You can terminate the process early by specifying an execution time limit.
en-US.name: Ultra Defragmenter
